author: m. c. wolf
title: ULM track & field opens indoor season at LSU Purple Tiger meet
text:
ULM’s track and field team is set to begin its 2026 indoor season at the LSU Purple Tiger meet in Baton Rouge on Friday, January 16. The event will feature 11 schools, including host LSU, Sun Belt Conference rival Ragin’ Cajuns, Southeastern, Nicholls, and Southern.
The competition day starts with field events at 9 a.m., beginning with the women’s and men’s weight throw. The men’s pole vault follows at 10:30 a.m. At noon, three events—the men’s and women’s long jump and the women’s shot put—will take place. The women’s high jump and pole vault are scheduled for 12:30 p.m., while the men’s shot put begins at 1:30 p.m. Field events conclude at 2 p.m. with the triple jump and men’s high jump.
Running events start with the women’s 600m race, followed by the men’s event. The afternoon continues with semifinals for both the 60m hurdles and 60m sprint before their finals. Later running events include the 1000m at 2:10 p.m., followed by races in the 400m, mile, 200m, and 2000m distances. The meet concludes with the 4x400m relays.
Fans can follow live results through links available on ULM’s track and field schedule page by selecting “Live Results” for each meet.
After this weekend’s meet, ULM will remain in Baton Rouge to compete in the LSU Bayou Bengal on Friday, January 23.
The men’s roster for this meet includes athletes such as Imani Coleman (60m), Dylan Hayden (60m, hurdles), Taj Morris (60m, hurdles), Andrew Nolan (60m), Seneca Portlock (60m, 400m), Santana Richardson (60m), J’Marcus Sewell (60m), Thibault Buchard (600m, relay), Danny Hagan (600m), Matthew Malcolm (600m, relay), Mario Santin (600m, relay), Kilian Mika (1000m), Joseph Morgan (1000m), Raymond Gomez (mile), River Richard (mile), Silas Christie (2000m), Joshua Giil (2000m), Chase Gunn (2000m) among others competing in various track and field disciplines.
The women’s lineup features Mikayla Douglas (60m, hurdles, relay), Kalli Husband (60m, hurdles, relay), Hanyla Millgan (60m, 200m), Keniya Simpson (60m, 200m, relay), Courtney Smith (60m, hurdles, relay), Briana Taylor (60m, relay) along with Mary Johnson and Monika Ortiz in the 400 meters; Rebekka Flotho leads entries in both middle distance races; Cora Burger competes in high jump and triple jump; Sydney Lake participates in weight throw.
